findings.detail: Longwood tussock — plant_type_label rewritten though the round never seeded it
findings.why: Carex comans, seeded before round 12, read 'Ornamental grass'. A sedge, not a grass. Corrected to 'Ornamental sedge' by scripts/fix-round12-tags.ts, matching Carex buchananii, elata and muskingumensis which already read that way. plant_type stays `grass` deliberately — that field is the Explore filter bucket and is horticultural by the July 10 2026 ruling (docs/architecture.md#plant-type-label); only the reader-facing label changed.

findings.detail: Orange New Zealand sedge — plant_type_label rewritten though the round never seeded it
findings.why: Carex testacea, seeded before round 12, read 'Evergreen ornamental grass'. Corrected to 'Evergreen ornamental sedge' — its own evergreen wording kept, only the noun changed. Same reasoning as Carex comans.

findings.detail: Great wood-rush — plant_type_label rewritten though the round never seeded it
findings.why: Luzula sylvatica, seeded before round 12, read 'Evergreen perennial grass'. Luzula is a wood-rush (Juncaceae). Corrected to 'Evergreen perennial wood-rush'. Its sibling Luzula nivea already reads 'Evergreen perennial rush' and was NOT touched: it is is_curated = true, and a curated row is not re-worded by a mechanical pass even to make two labels match.
